about: Things only Jay can confirm. Shown on the Questions for Jay screen and in QUESTIONS-FOR-JAY.md.

questions.q: Your reformer springs: is red heavy, blue medium and yellow light right for your studio? How many springs does each reformer have?
questions.why: Every spring color in the app is a guess based on Balanced Body.

questions.q: Reformer about 70 percent: did you mean 70 percent of each class, or that 70 percent of your classes use the reformer?
questions.why: The app aims for about 70 percent of each class on the reformer.

questions.q: What is the closing pull down? A standing roll down, or something on the springboard or reformer?
questions.why: The last block is set up as standing roll downs and calm finishing moves.

questions.q: I added two blocks: side work (4 minutes) and a stretch (4 minutes). Are those the right two, in the right places?
At Level 1, is a small head and shoulders curl (HNS) fine?
questions.why: The app allows it at Level 1 and does not count it as a body part lifting.

questions.q: At Level 1, is side-lying leg work (one leg at a time) unilateral for you?
questions.why: The app treats it as unilateral, so it waits until Level 1.5.

questions.q: Limited chair at Level 1.5: is up to 12 minutes of easy chair work about right?
questions.why: That is the limit the app uses.

questions.q: Plank on the reformer with feet on the platform: where are the hands, footbar or carriage?
questions.why: The app shows hands on the footbar.

questions.q: For older clients, is one trip down to the floor per class the right limit?
questions.why: The app never sends older clients to the floor more than once.

questions.q: Is kneeling on the carriage (knee stretches, kneeling arm work) fine for your older clients?
questions.why: The app allows it from Level 1.5.

questions.q: Does the 10 minute long box rule also apply when the box is turned the short way for abs?
questions.why: The app treats both as the box being on.

questions.q: On the chair, which spring settings do you call light, medium and heavy?
questions.why: Chair springs show as light, medium or heavy with no hole positions yet.
